title: Rev5.1 Context Boundaries & Investigation Continuity

architecture.path: interface -> runtime/service -> AgentSession -> administrative structured handshake -> main LLM <-> 16 deterministic tools/live workspace -> Evidence Core -> deterministic Final Gate -> Claim Review -> local Claim/Gap/Finding recovery or directed follow-up -> response
architecture.structured_contract: Eyle owns one canonical contract per structured profile; provider enforcement is opportunistic and local validation is always authoritative
architecture.capability_discovery: behavioral probe per transport+base_url+resolved_model, persisted machine-locally and revalidated after process restart or structural failure
architecture.semantic_2fa: Claim Review remains the only semantic final verifier; Claims and Evidence are proportional to material content with no numeric count quota
architecture.final_gate: deterministic only: final shape, write authority, required/known Evidence IDs and formatting
architecture.write_path: action=patches -> direct transaction dry-run -> user confirmation -> direct transaction apply -> compile/tests/reread/rollback
architecture.context_boundary: request is the only active task; conversation_background is stable, bounded, non-authoritative context; investigation_map is current-task navigation state preserved across semantic follow-up

adaptive_structured_handshake.cached_mode_policy: probe cached mode first on first process use; two failures required before invalidation
adaptive_structured_handshake.runtime_revalidation: a structural violation re-probes the known mode; capability changes trigger renegotiation and one repeat through the new mode
adaptive_structured_handshake.transport_failures: timeouts/connection failures are not interpreted as capability downgrades

structured_invariants: schema and local parser derive from the same profile definition
reasoning_content is never executable structured output
no embedded-JSON scanning or alternate protocol translation
prompt mode is an explicit verified capability, not a hidden fallback
the core never branches on provider/model identity

canonical_claim_review.claim_count_policy: all materially necessary atomic Claims; ~6/12/20+ are guidance, never quotas or limits
canonical_claim_review.evidence_count_policy: all materially necessary Evidence; ~6/12/20+ are guidance, never quotas or limits
canonical_claim_review.top_level_protocol_recovery: one explicit profile-aware structural retry with observed/missing keys
canonical_claim_review.local_protocol_recovery: locally-addressable Claim, Semantic Gap and Finding consistency failures are re-evaluated without discarding valid review content; runtime never invents semantic repairs

semantic_gap_evidence_contract.material_omission: requires one or more supplied Evidence IDs
semantic_gap_evidence_contract.conflicting_evidence: requires the relevant supplied Evidence IDs
semantic_gap_evidence_contract.scope_gap: may use an empty Evidence list when the gap is caused by missing/partial investigation

canonical_claim_review.semantic_gap_recovery: an invalid local gap is re-evaluated alone; verifier may preserve/reclassify with valid Evidence or remove it; all unaffected Claims, Findings and Semantic Gaps are preserved
canonical_claim_review.finding_recovery: Finding coverage inconsistencies regenerate only the complete Findings array from preserved Claims; Claims and Semantic Gaps remain unchanged and the full review is revalidated

paired_proxy.name: Eyle Qwen Proxy
paired_proxy.requirement: response_format is forwarded unchanged; the proxy may handle auth/model/thinking/timeouts but may not weaken Eyle's structured contract

publication_baseline.functional_scope: context boundaries, investigation continuity, anti-loop coordination, Finding recovery and explicit four-call agent batch contract

rev5_1.conversation_boundary: conversation_background remains available across all turns of a job; old tasks do not become active goals and explicit ongoing user instructions may remain applicable until revoked
rev5_1.investigation_continuity: a compact investigation_map is derived from observable successful tool history and survives CLAIM_INSUFFICIENT even when bulky tool/source views are cleared
rev5_1.anti_loop: blocked reads do not count as executed identical tool calls; they feed no-progress and return the prior observable map
rev5_1.tool_batch_contract: agent tool_calls are capped at 4 in provider schema and local parser; runtime no longer silently slices larger batches
rev5_1.failed_job_history: assistant messages from failed agent jobs are tagged and excluded from later conversational background
rev5_1.finding_recovery: local verifier regeneration repairs Findings coverage after Claim recovery without changing preserved Claims or Semantic Gaps
